newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Optek to pay $89 mln for 2 businesses.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Optek to pay $89 mln for 2 businesses.

text.p: Thermo Optek Corp, a maker of analytical intrumentation devices, on Tuesday said it agreed in principle to pay about $89 million for two divisions currently under the control of Thermo Instrument Systems Inc.
Thermo Instrument is the majority owner of Thermo Optek.

Thermo Optek said it would buy Spectronic Instruments Inc and VG Systems Ltd from Thermo Instrument for $41 million and $49 million, respectively. The deal would involve payment of cash, Thermo Instrument debt and/or the issuance of Thermo Optek stock, the company said in a statement.

In 1996, Spectronic, a supplier of UV/Vis spectrophotometers, reported revenues of $30 million, while VG Systems Ltd, a maker of material and surface science analysis equipment, had revenues of $62 million.
All of these companies are subsidiaries of Thermo Electron Corp, a diversified engineering company based in Massachusetts.
